S2: Run the same claims with no logo text.
S3: Run nameClaimsOf on an Instagram row whose profile name equals its handle.

S4: Read fictional sports-club and bakery logos through the environment vision fallback, then synthesize the brief with an Instagram name equal to its handle. Check the operator source reason when no vision model exists and check stale or missing model price budgets.
expect: S1: the suggested name is Harbour Sport Club, never harbour.sportclub.
S2: today's name (Padel & Tennis Coach) stays; a handle is never suggested.
S3: the profile name is recorded as the handle only, and the read with the logo suggests Harbour Sport Club.

fence: Pure domain functions, no network and no Postgres
